DISC-02 correction 2: modelDiscovery kind session semantics

kind:'session' does NOT mean models are never listed pre-session. Source: the client model-catalog probe spawns a disposable card process (<program> acp --session-dir <dataDir>/acp-listing-sessions/omp, fullAccess:false), initializes, session/news, and reads the models state in the session/new response (SessionModelState: availableModels [{modelId,name,description?}] + currentModelId); if the card advertises session deletion the listing session is deleted, otherwise (omp) the throwaway folder covers it; folderless workspaces are refused ('<agent> lists in a chat folder'). listingNamesConfiguredModel:false is a picker-semantics flag (listing does not name the configured model as CLI default), not a no-list statement. The /model slash prompt stays the in-chat SWITCH mechanism: write priority is model config option -> session/set_model (when models state was published) -> /model prompt fallback, plus /model retry when a native write is refused with the 'Unknown ACP model: ' prefix; resolvesSelectorsFrom 18.1.9 gates an update-hint diagnostic. Wrapper decision input: publishing no models field keeps switches on the /model prompt path exclusively
verdict: CORRECTED — doc Open item 2 rewritten; flagged for Phases 4-7
